title: An Objectively Okay Resource Pack ( by Alma )
description: An UNFINISHED resource pack that gives all textures and (sometime soon) some models in the game a fresh and fancy new look!
body:
I started this resoruce pack with the simple goal in mind of changing the way the game looks by giving it my own style, i try to make the new sprites look unique and stylish while also fitting well with the base game.

As of now only some of the most "common" Item sprites have been changed, you can check out the progress on my twt: [@BronznTelescope](https://x.com/BronznTelescope)
